findings.evidence: `TauCeti/Analysis/PDE/LowerOrder.lean:48` defines `driftForm` using `ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ... (innerSL ℝ b)`; `mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Operator/Bilinear.lean:418` defines `ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL`; `mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/InnerProductSpace/LinearMap.lean:164` defines `innerSL`.
findings.fix: Define it with Mathlib’s combinators, e.g. `(ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ n) ℝ).comp (innerSL ℝ)` or the equivalent `InnerProductSpace.toDualMap` CLM, then keep the apply simp lemma.
findings.issue: `driftFormLinear` manually proves linearity of `b ↦ driftForm b`, but `driftForm` is already `ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ... (innerSL ℝ b)`.

findings.evidence: `TauCeti/Analysis/PDE/LowerOrder.lean:52` defines `massForm c` as `c • ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ`; `mathlib/Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Operator/Mul.lean:189` provides `ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul`, with `lsmul_apply` at line 193 giving `c • x`.
findings.fix: Replace the raw `LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap` proof with `(ContinuousLinearMap.lsmul ℝ ℝ).flip (ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ)` for the target operator space.
findings.issue: `massFormLinear` manually rebuilds the map `c ↦ c • ContinuousLinearMap.mul ℝ ℝ`, duplicating Mathlib’s bundled scalar-multiplication CLM.

summary: Two lower-order coefficient maps manually rederive continuous-linear-map structure that Mathlib already provides. Reuse the existing CLM combinators instead of proving additivity and homogeneity by extensionality.
